documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.basketball.cba — 27 endpoints. Note: Unofficial and unsupported: the routes cbaleague.com's own data site (a Vue SPA) calls. SportsDataverse has not ruled on the site's terms, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets. Requests are spaced at least 1 s apart; keep use small. Note: Access: every response body is AES-128-ECB encrypted with a public key shipped in the site's bundle; cba_runtime decrypts it (stdlib implementation, no dependency) and refuses anything that does not decrypt. The host blocks datacenter IPs at TCP: set the environment variable CBA_PROXY to a residential proxy URL (it is never logged). Without it the request goes direct and, from a datacenter, fails within seconds (a 5 s connect timeout, no retry of a dropped connection). Where direct access works (a residential IP), set CBA_DIRECT=1 for the full 60 s timeout and retries. Note: Seasons: the API's season is the START year; every season argument here is the END year (2026 = 2025-26) and the runtime sends season - 1. Columns named season keep the wire value (the START year, so sdv END = season + 1). The season list reaches 1995-96; box data before 2009-10 is unverified. Note: Coverage: game wrappers serve FINISHED games only (an unfinished game raises AssetFetchError). Play-by-play is verified on 2017-18 and 2025-26 only and is absent for 2009-10 (NoDataError). There are NO shot x/y coordinates in this API: shot location exists only as team and player zone splits. Play-by-play has no player or team ids (Chinese sentence text plus surnames). Box data has 12-minute quarters in 2009-10 and 2017-18 and 10-minute quarters in 2025-26; the women's CBA is not covered (no official source). Note: Not game data: cba_game_team_shots and cba_game_team_four answer the two teams' SEASON tables (the shot zones are the teams' current profile; the four factors are the previous season), whichever game is asked for; rows cannot be scoped to the game. The reference lists (cba_team_options, cba_team_counts) and cba_report_status are not echoed by the API, so their scope is unchecked. Note: Duplicate rows: in some games (2025-26 game 100105799) the advanced-box and extras routes repeat player rows (26 rows for 12 players); the repeats are not always copies. cba_player_advanced and cba_player_extras keep the FIRST row per player_id. Note: Text fields are Chinese (names, sentences, position and nationality labels); the column descriptions carry the English glosses, and tools/codegen/notes/cba_glossary.yaml holds the full nationality, position, team-name and play-by-play phrase glossaries. Note: Personal data: the operator ids (createdBy / lastModifiedBy, one holds a mobile number) are removed from every body. Players' public bio fields (birth date, height, weight) are kept.
